description: Browse, search and completely delete local Claude Code and Codex conversations: transcripts, sub-agent logs, file snapshots, temp folders and helper threads.
container.title: Session Sweeper
view.name: Conversations
welcome.none:
No Claude Code or Codex data was found on this machine.

If you keep it in a non-standard location, set the data folders in the settings.

[Open Settings](command:sessionSweeper.openSettings)
config.deleteMode: What happens to Claude Code data when a conversation is deleted. Codex conversations are always deleted permanently, by Codex's own `codex delete` command.
config.deleteMode.trash: Move to the Recycle Bin / Trash, so a mistake can be undone.
config.groupBy: How conversations are grouped in the list.
config.groupBy.folder: By the folder they were started in.
config.sortBy.title: By title.
config.claude.dataDir: Claude Code data folder. Leave empty to use `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, or `~/.claude` when that is not set.
config.codex.dataDir: Codex data folder. Leave empty to use `CODEX_HOME`, or `~/.codex` when that is not set.
config.codex.executablePath: Path to the Codex command-line program, used to delete Codex conversations. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the Codex extension, or the one on your `PATH`.
